verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents a one-click sweep that clears non-important email in bulk, plus plain-English AI filters that automatically label, star or archive many emails. A user reports clearing a weeks-old inbox in about 10 minutes, which loosely corroborates this. Missing for 10: explicit multi-select bulk actions across arbitrary threads, AI-assistant-driven bulk operations (e.g., 'archive all newsletters from X'), documentation of scale or limits, and hands-on evidence of the bulk features themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest.
Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
In 10min I cleared my inbox which I was postponing for a few weeks
